data.description: IJKPlayer 是一款基于 FFmpeg 的轻量级 Android/iOS 视频播放器，具有 API 易于集成、编译配置可裁剪、支持硬件加速解码、DanmakuFlameMaster 架构清晰、简单易用等优势。
data.label: IJKPlayer

data.description: IJKPlayer is a lightweight Android/iOS video player based on FFmpeg, with advantages such as easy-to-integrate APIs, customizable compile configurations, support for hardware-accelerated decoding, a clear DanmakuFlameMaster architecture, and ease of use.
data.label: IJKPlayer
